title: Signed source-shift natural isomorphism for the sheaf Hom complex
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a small site and $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings. Let $A$ be the category of sheaves of modules over the underlying ring sheaf. For any unbounded cochain complex $L$ in $A$ and integer $m$, the functor $M\mapsto \mathcal Hom^\bullet(L,M)[-m]$ is naturally isomorphic to $M\mapsto \mathcal Hom^\bullet(L[m],M)$, where the Hom-complex bifunctor is [def-pur-hom-complex]. No injectivity, flatness or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0A8X, section-hom-complexes, displayed Hom differential; signed reindexing calculation in step 2 of lem-pur-derived-internal-hom-shift-left.

proof.text: Use the product projections and their universal property. In degree k, construct the forward map with p-th component (-1)^(m*k) times projection p+m in Hom(L,M) degree k-m. Construct the inverse by projection p-m in Hom(L[m],M) degree k, followed by the equality isomorphism identifying L^(p-m+m) with L^p and the same sign. Projection extensionality proves both inverse identities, since the scalar squares to one.

Check the chain identity after projection to each p-th factor in degree k+1. Expand both differentials using the specified Hom differential. The source shift contributes (-1)^m; source precomposition has coefficient -(-1)^k and target precomposition has -(-1)^(k+m). The scalar in degree k+1 is the scalar in degree k times (-1)^m. These equalities give agreement of the two postcomposition and precomposition terms. Build the chain isomorphism with HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents.

For a chain map M to N, expand its Hom-complex map after every projection. Postcomposition commutes with the integer scalar and the reindexing, so the forward maps are natural. NatIso.ofComponents assembles the natural isomorphism. All index arithmetic and sign identities hold for arbitrary integers; at m=0 the reindexing and signs are identities and zero complexes give the zero maps.

theorem homComplex_shift_left
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    (L : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ) (m : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (((homComplexFunctor (R := R)).obj (op L) ⋙ shiftFunctor _ (-m)) ≅
      (homComplexFunctor (R := R)).obj (op (L⟦m⟧)))
